svg.title: Inside a Grafana Cloud market stack
svg.desc: Six logical capability layers separate platform controls, telemetry connections, identity, content, operations and optional workload products from the external systems they depend on.
svg.text: Read from the foundation upwards. Layers separate responsibilities, not servers.
WHAT THE VENDING MACHINE CAN MANAGE
Named kinds are grounded in the activated provider inventory.

g.text: Give the stack an identity and a controlled bootstrap path.
Telemetry policies and instance admin access are separate grants.
The managed services hold the signals; connection resources
describe how Grafana queries or collects from other systems.
Mimir, Loki, Tempo and Pyroscope are service context, not four emitted CRDs.
Translate identity into team membership, actions and scopes.
Authentication, query grants and content ACLs are different controls.
Use observed team IDs; the external IdP and its registrations remain outside.
Shared content and local content can have different ownership.
Whole-set permission resources need one declarative writer.
Git provisioning is a selectable preview path, not a default source of content.
Define detection, notification routing and responder schedules.
The alert tree and OnCall escalation graph have separate owners.
Responders and notification destinations are dependencies, not vended people.
Add workload-specific products when a market selects them.
Each still needs real targets, queries, origins or evaluation inputs.
Availability, entitlement and terms vary; this view promises no default activation.

svg.text: Team Sync depends on IdP setup.
Exploded spacing is an editorial device. This is a logical Grafana Cloud service model, not a physical deployment or creation sequence.
